posts.body:
What is your VE_SPRITE_SUFFIX set to?
Since you are using sprite and the default is
VE_SPRITE_SUFIX = "[anim]"
You don't need to put [anim] in the battler name, as shown in the video you linked.
If you deleted VE_SPRITE_SUFIX = "" then I'm not sure.
